_comment: Connectors and scenarios that run in production, and the scenarios that
guard them. A change to shared code — proto, core, harness — certifies only
this list, because it is the only set whose failure means a real payment
would break. Everything else is certified by the PR that touches it.
This list is not derivable from the repository: it records which
integrations are actually live, which is a fact about deployment, not code.
Add an entry when a connector goes live for a payment method, and name the
scenario rather than the suite — scenario names carry the payment method,
so listing them is how the set stays scoped to what is really enabled.
